requirements[0].file_spec.file_size.maxi.reasoning: No published signature file size for this body. Standing in with the modal published specification across the researched set (10-20 KB), which falls inside five of the six distinct published ranges. The arithmetic mean (10.6-45.2 KB) was rejected: its ceiling exceeds five of those six, and overshooting a maximum is a hard portal rejection.
